notes.title: Our biggest update yet!
notes.content:
[p][b]🚀 Major Game Update: Expanding the World, Deepening the Strategy![/b][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, and today we’re thrilled to say a [b]massive update[/b] that will bring new depth, polish, and possibilities to your gameplay experience. Let’s dive into what’s going to be new:[/p][p][/p][p][b]🌍 Resources & Commodities — A New Layer of Strategy[/b][/p][p]We’ve introduced [b]Resource and Commodity items[/b] across the World Map and in Stores. These can now be [b]found or purchased[/b], and they’re key to our new [b]card fusion system[/b]. That’s right—players can now [b]combine items to upgrade and enhance[/b] their existing cards, unlocking powerful new synergies and tactical flexibility.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332678/b1370f91bb1d28163ddb0ffc820a6ee32f519028.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🗺️ UI & World Map Enhancements[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]UI has been refined[/b] to give you a [b]fuller, more immersive view[/b] of the world map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Events and outcomes now auto-save[/b], meaning every decision counts. You’ll encounter [b]once-off events[/b] where opportunities can be seized—or lost forever. Choose wisely.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🃏 Card System Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve expanded the [b]branching structure[/b] of the card framework, introducing [b]new paths and progression logic[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Card weighting has been rebalanced[/b], and requirements for higher-level cards have been fine-tuned for a more rewarding climb.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Single Player mode[/b] now features [b]50 new cards[/b], giving you more variety and strategic options. Note: the number of levels has been reduced to streamline progression and reflect the new structure.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332678/b345a662eb359cbbb590779d8099276bdae8e8f1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🔧 Backend Migration — Underway![/b][/p][p]We’re currently [b]20% through a major backend migration[/b]. The data volume is substantial, and we’re actively testing the migrated content in-game to ensure stability and performance. This is a big step toward future scalability and smoother updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🔊 Audio & Dialogue — A Richer Soundscape[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New music tracks[/b] have been added to elevate the mood and atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue and SFX[/b] now accompany events on the [b]world map and town maps[/b], adding emotional weight and narrative texture.[/p][/*][*][p]Work has begun on a [b]sound options menu[/b], giving players more control over their audio experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332678/ab30314a5a7aeaf49b1d8ea601bdfe5b8b273701.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update marks a major milestone in our journey, and we’re just getting started. Thank you for being part of this evolving world—we can’t wait to hear what you think and see how you play.[/p][p]Stay sharp, stay curious,
[b]
-SCG Team-[/b][/p]

notes.title: Days of Sass & Glory!
notes.content: [p]Hey players! We’ve been listening, tuning, and polishing—today's patch brings some spicy enhancements, quality-of-life improvements, and just a hint of NPC-generated chaos. Here's what's new in this build:[/p][p][/p][p]🆚 [b]Versus Screen Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Overhauled UI layout and transitions for all versus encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced visual clarity with improved animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Prep for battle with flair—your rival deserves the spotlight too.[/p][/*][/list][p]💬 [b]NPC Smacktalk System[/b][/p][list][*][p]NPCs now engage in contextual trash talk on the worldmap and random encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Expect sass, unsolicited advice, and rude commentary based on your general existence, choices, or recent failures. You’ve been warned.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎧 [b]Sound & UI Enhancements[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332678/1dc4f3e30b9a911b2967bcc72276845facdaea01.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Rebalanced sound FX across combat, menus, and ambient zones.[/p][/*][*][p]Fine-tuned UI audio cues for smoother interaction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Feature:[/b] Main Menu now includes a [b]Music Mute Button[/b]—silence the theme song without losing your pride.[/p][/*][/list][p]📅 [b]Event System Introduced (Demo Version)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332678/f2ae544f563ac5f4cfb5f6b02ce22580642ccc63.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Implemented an annual cycle of 12 major events that shake up gameplay, introduce unique mechanics, and spotlight special characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Demo includes 2 playable events for early access participants. Each features exclusive drops and storyline content.[/p][/*][/list][p]🕒 [b]Day Counter Mechanic Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]In-game day tracking now affects item drops, NPC behavior, event frequency, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Some days bring rare loot, some invite abuse from NPCs, others are weirdly quiet. It’s all part of the cycle.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]🔥 [b]World Map Opened Up[/b][/p][list][*][p]We decided to remove the majority of the solid UI from the screen in place of seeing a lot more of the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Enables you to see some events as they happen on the world map, should you be lucky.[/p][/*][*][p]It's also just nicer to look at.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]⚙️ Various minor bug fixes and performance optimizations under the hood and new teaser in the store & on website.[/p]

notes.title: Tweaks, Fixes & Secrets
notes.content:
[p]🎮 [b]Game Update – Tactical Depth, Visual Flair & Audio Enhancements![/b] 🎨🎵[/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a [b]medium-sized update[/b] packed with quality-of-life improvements, visual upgrades, and a few surprises that we think you’ll love. Here’s what’s new:
[/p][p]🧩 [b]A New Era of Tactical Play (Coming Soon)[/b]
We’re laying the groundwork for a brand-new update system that will change the way you will approach fusing and upgrading cards. We’re keeping the details under wraps for now, but get ready to think more strategically..
[/p][p]🗺️ [b]World Map Art Overhaul[/b]
The world map has been refreshed with beautiful, hand-drawn artwork. It’s a big step toward making the game world feel more alive—and we’ll continue refining it as needed.
[/p][p]🎵 [b]Audio Enhancements[/b][/p][list][*][p]A brand-new [b]theme song[/b] has been added to set the tone, this will be used in our advertising also.[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of new [b]sound effects[/b] have been introduced to make battles and interactions more immersive.[/p][/*][/list][p]⚔️ [b]Versus Screen Polish[/b]
The Versus screen has received some extra love—expect a more dynamic and polished look when facing off against opponents and special opponents......shhh
[/p][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where opponents couldn’t play their last card.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player always started first.
[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, thank you for your continued support and feedback. We’re excited about where the game is headed—and we can’t wait to share more with you soon.[/p]

notes.title: Day/Night & Monthly Events
notes.content:
The day and night event system will significantly enhance player immersion and engagement by introducing dynamic environmental changes and time-sensitive challenges. Players experience evolving gameplay as the in-game world transitions between daylight and nighttime phases, each bringing unique mechanics, enemy behaviors, rewards, and opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332678/5814c129da7dd554d0ef2d5bb95e902ce41d74cd.gif[/img]

During the day, events might favor exploration, resource gathering, or lighter encounters, while nighttime introduces heightened danger, stronger adversaries, or exclusive quests that require strategic adaptation. This keeps players engaged by offering variety and incentivizing participation across different time periods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332678/647a0d8eaf59a96a5e24a324ea567c2d762dabc8.gif[/img]

To further enrich the experience, a monthly bonus event introduces a special, limited-time challenge that builds anticipation and excitement. This event could incorporate seasonal themes, rare rewards, or cooperative challenges that encourage player interaction and foster community engagement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332678/67d61adb2c7c1ef84bb69023331148ab75871b80.gif[/img]

Implementing this system will ensure replayability, rewards consistent participation, and sustains long-term interest by creating an ever-evolving world that feels alive and reactive.
